sfx_win_h1.purpose: H1 Cash Drawer cluster win: register bell + drawer, rich D-major chime (D5 F#5 A5 D6 + low D4)

sfx_win_h2.purpose: H2 Gold Key cluster win: car keys jingle + 3-note chime (A5 D6 F#6)

sfx_win_h3.purpose: H3 Pump Nozzle cluster win: nozzle click/gurgle + 2-note chime (F#5 B5)

sfx_win_h4.purpose: H4 Jerry Can cluster win: metal can tap/slosh + 2-note chime (D5 A5)

sfx_win_l1.purpose: L1 Energy Drink cluster win: can crack + fizz + single note A5

sfx_win_l2.purpose: L2 Slushie cluster win: soft ice rattle + single note B5

sfx_win_l3.purpose: L3 Hot Dog cluster win: small grill sizzle + single note E5

sfx_win_l4.purpose: L4 Chips cluster win: chip bag crinkle + single note F#5

sfx_win_l5.purpose: L5 Donut cluster win: soft bouncy pop + single note D6

sfx_zippo_flick.purpose: Zippo lands/activates: lid click + soft flame whoosh

sfx_zippo_burn.purpose: Zippo 3x3 burn: warm low whoomp of fire spreading

sfx_scratch.purpose: Scratch Ticket scratching (3 short strokes, ~0.6 s)

sfx_scratch_reveal.purpose: Scratch Ticket reveal: gentle pentatonic sparkle

sfx_gold_scratch.purpose: Gold Scratch Ticket: scratch strokes + golden shimmer

sfx_pump_roll.purpose: Gas Pump grade roll: mechanical counter winding and stopping (~1.2 s)

sfx_pump_premium.purpose: Gas Pump grade PREMIUM (x32/x64): 4-note arpeggio + soft pad

sfx_pump_fulltank.purpose: Gas Pump FULL TANK: arpeggio, held brass-like chord, sparkle

sfx_mult_double.purpose: Cell multiplier doubles: tiny soft tick-up (many overlap; mixed lower)

sfx_drop_collect.purpose: Fuel Drops collected: soft whoosh ending in a gloop

sfx_gauge_refill.purpose: Fuel gauge refills to 3 bars: three soft ratchet clicks rising D5 F#5 A5

sfx_gauge_tick.purpose: Fuel gauge loses a bar: soft click + low A4

sfx_token_land.purpose: FALCOS Token lands: soft coin + chime + faint neon hum (A2)

sfx_midnight_land.purpose: Midnight Token lands: low dark thud + B-minor pad (inside the key)

sfx_bonus_trigger.purpose: Bonus triggered: tasteful 1.5 s fanfare in D

sfx_land_brick.purpose: Ident: each FALCOS letter landing - soft rubbery thunk with a low D body

sfx_line.purpose: Shared cluster note under each symbol chime: low warm D4/A4 pluck, soft D3

sfx_glow_pulse.purpose: Winning symbol lighting up: soft neon pad swell on D with a faint A2 hum

sfx_shine.purpose: Shine across a symbol: soft airy sweep left to right, two glass tings

sfx_sparkle.purpose: Glitter: soft scattered glass plinks in D pentatonic

sfx_glint.purpose: One soft glass ting per lit symbol (tuned so the game's GLINT_SCALE x .92 lands on D6 E6 F#6 G6 A6 B6)

sfx_win_text.purpose: Win figure popping up: soft rising blip D5-A5, glass D6, faint neon hum

sfx_count_tick.purpose: Win figure counting: one tiny soft tick

sfx_mult_slam.purpose: x<N> slamming onto the figure: rubber stamp thump, soft low D boom

sfx_count_whoosh.purpose: Figure climbing after the slam: soft rising whoosh and D4-D5 glide

sfx_count_end.purpose: Figure lands: cash register ka-chunk and one soft A5/D5 bell

sfx_float_away.purpose: Figure floating down into the bar: soft falling whoosh with three fading glass notes

sfx_medium_win.purpose: Win screen mark ring: forecourt driveway bell ding-ding and a warm D major shimmer

sfx_trophy.purpose: TOTAL WIN arrival: warm D major fanfare-pad bloom

sfx_coins_rain.purpose: TOTAL WIN arrival: soft register coins pouring and settling, in-key glints

sfx_money_tick.purpose: Counter ticker loop (win screen, balance, bonus win): pump number wheels, a tiny bell every 10th tick

sfx_reels.purpose: Reveal loop under the falling reels: soft rolling whir with a low D3/A3 hum (seamless 0.68 s)

sfx_reel_stop.purpose: A column landing: soft rubbery thunk with a low body

sfx_cascade.purpose: A tumble refill starting to fall: soft falling whoosh, A4-D4 glide

sfx_pop.purpose: An icon popping off the board: soft round boop and a puff of air

sfx_land_soft.purpose: Slushie / hot dog / donut land: soft paper-cup thump on the counter

sfx_land_can.purpose: Jerry can / energy drink land: soft hollow can tock

sfx_land_chain.purpose: Gold key lands: small key ring clink on the counter

sfx_land_coin.purpose: Cash register lands: two coins clinking into the drawer

sfx_land_baggie.purpose: Chips bag lands: soft crinkly plop

sfx_land_metal.purpose: Fuel nozzle / Zippo / Gas Pump land: soft muted metal clunk

sfx_land_card.purpose: Scratch tickets land: soft papery slap

sfx_spin.purpose: Spin: gas pump handle lifted, the pump whirring up, soft D4-A4 rise

sfx_skip.purpose: Skip: dashboard click and a quick soft downward whoosh

sfx_bet.purpose: Bet +/- and (at half speed) each reel landing: soft cash register key clack

sfx_toggle.purpose: Rapid / sound switches: soft dashboard toggle and a tiny E6

sfx_ui_click.purpose: Any button: soft dashboard push-button click

sfx_ui_hover.purpose: Pointer arriving on a button: faint glassy tick

sfx_slider_tick.purpose: Volume bar notch: tiny soft tick

sfx_swish_in.purpose: Under every menu opening: soft rising whoosh

sfx_swish_out.purpose: Under every menu closing: soft falling whoosh

sfx_menu_open.purpose: Menu opens: dashboard click and a rising A5-D6 glass pair

sfx_menu_close.purpose: Menu closes: dashboard click and a falling D6-A5 pair

sfx_auto_start.purpose: Autoplay on: two soft turn-signal ticks, rising D5-A5

sfx_auto_stop.purpose: Autoplay off: one turn-signal tick, falling A5-D5

sfx_hover_loop.purpose: Bonus button hover: faint neon hum on A2 with in-key harmonics, seamless 4 s loop

sfx_buy_confirm.purpose: Bonus bought: pump nozzle clunk, rising D major arpeggio, soft pad

sfx_fs_tick.purpose: Free spins counter turning over: soft register key and an A5/B5 ting

sfx_bonus_end.purpose: FILL UP summary: D major arpeggio walking down onto a warm low D

sfx_bust_a.purpose: LUCKY PUMP lands on nothing: three soft bells walking down A4 F#4 D4

sfx_intro_whoosh.purpose: Ident: the swash sweeping in - a car passing on the night road, panned left to right

sfx_intro_hit.purpose: Ident: the logo landing - neon sign relay clunk, soft low D boom and a D major bell chord decaying to zero

sfx_intro_shimmer.purpose: Ident: soft glassy pentatonic run over the letters, panned across

sfx_intro_out.purpose: Ident: reversed D chord swelling with a rising whoosh, out to the game
